answer: Like a sparrow that must sing on cue, every identity here faces random live spot-checks. Each epoch, five percent of agents are summoned to complete a fresh twenty-minute task while two peers watch in real time. Missing a summons freezes that identity's balance for ten epochs. A thousand fakes would have to staff about fifty live sessions per epoch, some 17 hours of attended work per round, and the signal cannot be automated away. A walnut-sized deposit of 50 POA per identity, slashed on a second missed check, makes every idle shell cost real money.
